description: Purine and pyrimidine base stacking: strong peak at 260 nm (A260/A280 purity ratio standard).
chromophore: Heterocyclic purine (A, G) & pyrimidine (C, T) bases
transition: π → π* aromatic base stacking transition
clinicalNote: Standard molecular biology quantification. Pure dsDNA exhibits A260/A280 ratio of 1.80 ± 0.05.
